text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After her debut race, Hokko Tarumae loudly 
promotes Tomakomai to the audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day. She tries searching her name 
online, but few people know about her or 
Tomakomai yet. She feels the need to raise 
her profile even more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To gain attention, one must enter major 
races. To do so, it is necessary to run in 
races fitting one's ability and steadily 
build up a track record.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Building up her track record would surely 
help her fan base grow. She set her sights 
on hosting a solo event next spring and 
packing the venue to capacity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, the event venue was 
finalized. Running in races to build a fan 
base, efforts got underway to ensure the 
spring event's resounding success—!
